newsitem.title: USA: Alternate Postal, News Corp in alliance.
newsitem.headline: Alternate Postal, News Corp in alliance.

text.p: Alternate Postal Delivery Inc formed a strategic alliance with the News America FSI unit of News Corp to distribute product samples nationwide.

News America is the largest publisher of free-standing inserts in the United States and Canada and Alternate Postal is the largest U.S. private delivery company operating through magazines, newspapers, door-to-door canvassing and advertising publications, the companies said.
Terms of the alliance were not disclosed.
"We expect this alliance will significantly expand volume through our networks," said Alternate Postal president Phillip Miller.
